_about: Voice-over and on-screen subtitles for each film. Each line is one subtitle; words in *asterisks* are highlighted. Timing comes from the recorded audio when films/vo/<id>/<n>.wav exists, otherwise from word count (2.6 words/s). Facts checked against server/lab/engine. Never mention profit.

arena.title: The Arena
arena.subtitle: Where strategies are bred — and most of them die.
lines: Every trading strategy looks *brilliant* on the chart it was built on.
So here's the question nobody asks: was it *skill*… or just *luck*?
Meet the *Probe*. It's your strategy — its rules — driving through real price history: a currency, a stock, gold, oil.
But one road proves *nothing*. So we built a *sandbox*.
*144 worlds.* Currencies, *stocks*, *commodities*. Different stretches of history. Different trading costs — even orders that *fail to fill*.
Every version of the strategy runs through every world. *At the same time.*
Then the Arena does what markets do. The weakest get *wiped out*.
The strongest are *copied* — with small mutations to their settings.
Again. And again. *Twelve generations.* Every single version *counted*.
Because surviving here proves nothing yet. It earns one thing: *a shot at the Vault*.

gauntlet.title: The Gauntlet
gauntlet.subtitle: We try to break it before you ever trust it.
lines: A strategy that's never been attacked is a strategy you *can't trust*.
So we send in the *Hunter* — an adversary with one job: hit your *stop loss*.
It rips *gaps* into the price. It blows out the *spread*. It hits exactly where it hurts.
Survive that, and the sky changes. This is *Storm Mode*.
*200 simulated worlds* — reshuffled history, regime shifts, overnight and *earnings gaps*, spread blowouts.
Each world is a full rerun of the strategy, start to finish.
The rule is simple: *95%* of worlds must stay inside the drawdown limit.
Pass, and it earns a *Storm stamp*. Fail, and you find out *here* — not with your money.

vault.title: The Vault Exam
vault.subtitle: Data it has never seen. Opened once.
lines: Here's where most backtests *cheat*: they peek at the answers.
We lock away the last *20%* of history. The strategy has *never* seen it.
The Vault opens *once* per strategy. No retakes. No tweaking.
Inside, five gates. Gate one: *double the trading costs*. Does it still hold up?
Gate two: *the luck adjustment*. Every version the Arena tried is counted against it.
Gate three: does it beat our *default model* on the same data?
Gate four: is the *drawdown* inside the range we expected? Gate five: *enough trades* to mean something?
Pass them all: *Licensed*. Fall short: *probation* or *scrapped*. And the door *seals* behind it.

shadow.title: Shadow Run
shadow.subtitle: Live prices. Real decisions. No money.
lines: History is one thing. The *live market* is another.
In a Shadow Run, the strategy trades *real live prices* — forex, stocks or commodities — on paper.
Every decision is *locked in before the next bar* appears. No hindsight. Ever.
Beside it runs the *current champion*, making its own calls on the same prices.
Each result drops into the *record* — permanently.
An evidence meter fills as it proves itself *trade by trade* against the champion.
Only when the evidence is *strong enough* does it get promoted to *Live*.
shadow.end: Proof on live prices before any money

licensed.title: Licensed
licensed.subtitle: Earned — and watched every minute.
lines: Pass the Vault, survive the Shadow Run, and a strategy earns its *licence*.
But a licence isn't forever. Markets *change*.
So every licensed strategy runs above a *tripwire*.
It watches for *drift* — results sliding away from what the Vault promised — and drawdowns deeper than the Vault ever saw.
The moment it's crossed: *the licence is pulled*. Automatically. Back to the Shadow Run.
No ego, no hoping it comes back. It has to *earn it again*.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.subtitle: Tested with the costs you actually pay.
lines: Most backtests assume *perfect fills*. Your broker doesn't.
Every real order you place — a currency, a share, a barrel of oil — lands a little *off target*. That's *slippage*. Plus the *spread*.
Mirror measures it — fill after fill — and builds a *model of your real costs*.
Thin data? It leans on the average across traders on the *same broker*, until yours speaks for itself.
Then that cost model goes *straight into the Arena*.
So every strategy is tested with what *you* actually pay — not a fantasy.
mirror.end: Your fills. Your costs. Your tests.

forge.title: The Forge
forge.subtitle: New ideas, held to a bar that rises with every try.
lines: The Arena breeds strategies from building blocks called *layers* — trend, momentum, volatility.
The Forge *invents new layers*. Small formulas, built from safe pieces. Never code that runs.
Each one is tested on training data: does it *actually predict* what price does next?
But here's the twist: the bar *rises with every idea tried*. Try a thousand, and luck alone would find something — so the bar climbs.
*109 ideas tested. None has cleared the bar yet.* That's not failure. That's *honesty*.
When one does, it joins the Arena — earned, not wished for.

hive.title: Playbook · Hive · Fleet
hive.subtitle: What worked — kept, combined, balanced.
lines: Every licensed strategy becomes a *skill* in your Playbook — tagged by the market weather it handles: *calm, trending, volatile*.
The Arena reuses those skills, so your next strategy starts *smarter*.
Across everyone, licensed strategies quietly make predictions — scored on what actually happens.
The *Hive* blends them, weighting the ones with the best track record. At least *five* must agree to speak.
And the *Fleet* spreads your risk across strategies — tuned to soften the *worst days*, then checked on days it's never seen.

proof.title: Proof of Process
proof.subtitle: Every decision on the record — before its result.
lines: Anyone can *claim* a track record. We let you *check* ours.
Every decision is written to a *chain* — the instant it's made, *before* its outcome exists.
Each link carries a *fingerprint* of the one before it. Change one entry, and every link after it *breaks*.
At midnight, the whole day folds into *one seal*.
On any public strategy page, press *Verify* — and your own browser checks every link. No trust required.
